title: Credit on a part sale invoice lists an inactive part with its tag
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-01, Sell Price $20.00) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSCR-02, Sell Price $15.00) are tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in their default bins.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-A} (for example P2-89) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL PSCR Customer) is invoiced and sold one {Part-A} and one {Part-B}.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after the invoice was created; {Part-B} is active.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-sale-A} and its Finance tab.
  2. Open the invoice's ⋮ menu and click "Issue Credit".
  3. Tick "Parts are being returned".
  4. Read the "Parts to return" list.
  5. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Both parts are listed: {Part-A} at $20.00 and {Part-B} at $15.00. {Part-A} carries a grey "Inactive" tag right after its part number; {Part-B} has none.
  • Step 5: The credit dialog closes and nothing is issued.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R13, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.7 (Part sale credit: still offered, tagged), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R13: “A credit on any invoice, from a part sale or a work order, lists the parts sold on the invoice, active or inactive. A part that is now inactive carries the grey "Inactive" tag beside its part number.”
